title: Replay proposed witnesses with exact arithmetic
summary: Discover a candidate numerically, then verify a rational witness exactly.
content: Convert a proposed witness to rational data while preserving its required constraints, then check the decisive inequality using exact arithmetic.
whenToUse: An optimization experiment needs an independently checkable certificate.
limitations: A successful certificate proves only the checked claim. Failure to find one does not prove impossibility.
